verdict.rationale: Deel documents a dedicated API Sandbox explicitly described as a separate testing environment that won't affect production data, complete with pre-populated sample contracts/workers/organizations and a reset function for repeatable testing—well suited for AI-native agents to test against via API or MCP tools. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of sandbox behavior with actual AI agents, and no explicit mention of sandbox mode for the MCP server itself (only the REST API).
